evidence.title: VoiceGateway: the open-source profiler for voice agents
GitHub - mahimailabs/voicegateway: The One Dashboard every Voice Agent needs

name: VoiceGateway
summary: Open-source profiler that prices and times every STT, LLM and TTS call in a voice agent.
description: Add one line to a LiveKit or Pipecat agent and attach() meters each STT, LLM and TTS call: cost per call, latency by stage and one telemetry row per request, rolled up per call, agent and project in a dashboard you self-host. Includes invoice reconciliation, spend guards and a live demo on example data.
contains: one line (attach()) meters STT, LLM and TTS calls in LiveKit and Pipecat agents
cost per call, latency by stage (time to first audio, p95) and per-call timelines
voicegw reconcile checks recorded totals against provider usage exports
guard() adds a fallback chain, rate limit and daily budget
self-hosted collector, MIT licensed, no hosted version yet
live demo dashboard on example data
priced providers: OpenAI, Deepgram, Anthropic, Groq, Cartesia, ElevenLabs, AssemblyAI, Ollama, Kokoro, Piper
